name: macro-nowcast-dfm
what_it_holds: "Production-ready" GDP nowcasting engine combining Mixed-Frequency Dynamic Factor Models (labelled MIDAS in the description, effectively DFM+MIDAS hybrid) and Kalman filtering to extract real-time macro health signals; small repo (3 stars).
why_useful: Small but on-theme MIDAS/DFM/Kalman-filter engine (gap #17) that could be inspected for a compact, dependency-light implementation to adapt for an ABNB consumer-strength nowcast.
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
why_all: Small but on-theme MIDAS/DFM/Kalman-filter engine (gap #17) that could be inspected for a compact, dependency-light implementation to adapt for an ABNB consumer-strength nowcast.

name: GDP_Forecasting_With_MIDAS_Regressions
what_it_holds: Student/academic project forecasting GDP with MIDAS regressions using mixed-frequency macro indicators; includes data-prep, estimation, and evaluation code (2 stars).
why_useful: Small, readable MIDAS-in-Python worked example (gap #17); useful mainly as a teaching reference for implementing MIDAS weighting schemes (Almon lag etc.) rather than as a reusable package.
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
why_all: Small, readable MIDAS-in-Python worked example (gap #17); useful mainly as a teaching reference for implementing MIDAS weighting schemes (Almon lag etc.) rather than as a reusable package.

name: midas_capstone
what_it_holds: IE University capstone (2026) comparing MIDAS vs ARIMAX for forecasting US Consumer Energy CPI using weekly WTI oil futures data as the high-frequency indicator; includes CLM-SS (a novel MIDAS variant), LASSO-MIDAS, Kernel U-MIDAS, XGBoost and LSTM benchmarks.
why_useful: A recent (2026), reasonably rigorous academic comparison of several MIDAS variants against ML benchmarks on a real macro series (gap #17); the CLM-SS/LASSO-MIDAS/Kernel U-MIDAS code could be repurposed to mix weekly consumer/FX indicators into a quarterly ABNB KPI nowcast.
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
why_all: A recent (2026), reasonably rigorous academic comparison of several MIDAS variants against ML benchmarks on a real macro series (gap #17); the CLM-SS/LASSO-MIDAS/Kernel U-MIDAS code could be repurposed to mix weekly consumer/FX indicators into a quarterly ABNB KPI nowcast.

name: MIDAS-Nowcast
what_it_holds: Near-real-time forecasting of UK household savings using MIDAS regressions on mixed-frequency UK data (savings ratio target, higher-frequency indicators).
why_useful: On-theme MIDAS implementation (gap #17); UK household savings is a consumer-strength proxy loosely analogous to the OECD/consumer-confidence work already held, though geography (UK) is outside the team's core NA/APAC/LatAm focus.
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies

name: tsecon
what_it_holds: High-performance time-series econometrics library, Rust core with a Python-first API; markets itself as "validated estimators, a 15-chapter guide, and honest inference by default" — general econometric toolkit (not nowcasting-specific per se, but came up under the nowcasting search and covers mixed-frequency-adjacent estimators).
why_useful: General-purpose, fast time-series econometrics engine that could underlie custom bridge-equation/MIDAS estimation for ABNB KPIs if existing pure-Python tools (statsmodels) are too slow for repeated point-in-time refits across W1/W2 windows.
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
